keySource: The key is NYSED's own, read from the Map to the Standards in the released-items PDF and carried into provenance/itemmap_g6-2024.json by tools/extract_item_map.py. tools/merge_content.py re-checks every letter against that file item by item and refuses to build if one disagrees, so the key here cannot drift from the official table or be shifted by one released item. Every constructed-response answer below cites NYSED's own exemplary-response page and is checked against this project's transcription of the same item.

37.source: NYSED exemplary response, scoring materials page 7 (PDF page 8)

41.answer: Not equivalent: 3 times 3 plus 5x is 9 + 15x, not 6 + 8x
41.source: NYSED exemplary response, scoring materials page 32 (PDF page 33)
41.check: Distributing the 3 gives 9 + 15x. Both expressions are in this item's own transcribed stem.

42.answer: The total cost c depends on the number of tickets t, so c is the dependent variable and t the independent one; the cost rises $2.75 a ticket
42.source: NYSED exemplary response, scoring materials page 42 (PDF page 43)
42.check: The equation c = 2.75t is this item's own transcribed stem.

43.answer: No — 8 is a common factor of 24 and 40 and is greater than 4
43.source: NYSED exemplary response, scoring materials page 52 (PDF page 53)
43.check: 24 and 40 are both multiples of 8. Both numbers are in this item's own transcribed stem.
